# Statistic

- **layer** molecule
- **source** —
- **status** n/a

`common/statistic` — title in `gray700` at 1em (0.857em on mobile) with a 0.143em gap; value at 1.143em / 700, rising to 1.429em with `lead` and 1.571em with `leader`. Trends render `TiArrowSortedUp/Down` in success or danger plus an optional `since_when` line; `inlineTrends` moves the delta into the value suffix. Adjacent statistics gain a `gray100` inline-start divider with 16px padding. Lottie can replace the icon.
